name: Iris Prize for Nature (Iris, Stem and Seed Prizes)
summary: Annual prizes of $5,000 to $15,000 for youth-led projects (leaders aged 14 to 24) that protect or restore nature, mainly in the Global South, with mentoring and other support alongside the money.

fiscal_sponsor.note: Required when the applicant is a minor in their country: a local organisation or NGO

steps: Two references and an interview, if shortlisted

eligibility.rule: Having project or organisation leadership aged 14 to 24
Having most leadership be young people with project autonomy and decision-making power
Supporting protection and restoration of nature and rights defenders
Retaining complete autonomy and decision-making authority when fiscally sponsored or associated
If underage in your country, collaborating with a local organisation or NGO as fiscal sponsor

status.quote: The Iris Prize 2027 will open in March.

applicant_types.quote: Your project or organisation is led by young people aged 14 to 24.

geography.quote: We prioritise initiatives in the Global South, where our support can have a more significant impact. But we also consider exceptional projects from the Global North.

access.quote: March 1st at 11:00 CET Open call The Iris Prize 2027 will open.

window.quote: March 1st at 11:00 CET Open call The Iris Prize 2027 will open.

amount.quote: The Iris Prize $15,000 Awarded to an established project with the potential to replicate and scale. Ages 16-24 The Stem Prize $10,000 Awarded to an existing project established recently and on a small scale. Ages 16-24 The Seed Prize $5,000

fiscal_sponsor.quote: If you are under a minor in your country, please be aware that we require collaboration with a local organisation or NGO to serve as a fiscal sponsor.

effort.quote: Shortlisted candidates must provide two references for added validation to enhance transparency and credibility.
May Interviews All shortlisted applicants undergo brief due diligence interviews.
June Judging Panel Review The expert Judging Panel reviews the shortlist.

eligibility.quote: Your project or organisation is led by young people aged 14 to 24.
To be eligible for an Iris Prize, most of your leadership must be young people with project autonomy and decision-making power.
You support the principle of protecting and restoring nature and the rights of those working to defend it.
However, it is essential that the young person leading the project retains complete autonomy and decision-making authority.
If you are under a minor in your country, please be aware that we require collaboration with a local organisation or NGO to serve as a fiscal sponsor.
